about: What can be defended about each IMAX room the app knows, per field, with the source for every claim. Data only: nothing in the page reads this yet. Unknown is an answer, not a gap to fill with a guess.

confidence.verified: Read from the operator's own data (Cinemex's API or seat map), or measured by this project.
confidence.likely: Stated by independent press, or by the operator only at chain level rather than for this room. Two sources agreeing is still likely, not verified, unless one of them is the operator.
confidence.unknown: Not published, or the published sources contradict each other. The note says which.

cinemex_landing_imax.what: Cinemex's IMAX page. Lists its IMAX cinemas, and names four as laser in one sentence.
cinemex_landing_imax.quote: Ven a conocer nuestras nuevas pantallas IMAX Laser en Antara, Santa Fe, Parque Delta y Parque Tezontle y vive las emociones del cine al MAXIMO.

cinemex_seat_maps.what: The seat map of a real session in each room, counted seat by seat.

cinepremiere.author: Gustavo Pineda
cinepremiere.date: not shown on the page; written before the end of 2023

page_audit.url: docs/index.html, the venue audit's spec lines
page_audit.kind: this project's own audit, which already tags each line v / l / u
page_audit.note: Cited where the audit records a contradiction between sources that is not fetched again here.

resolution.note: Press only. Cinemex's own pages publish no resolution.

sound.note: Press only. '12-channel' appears nowhere in Cinemex's CMS (docs/cinema-extras.json spec_claims_not_sourced).

aspect_ratio.note: The digital IMAX ratio. Not the 1.43:1 of film IMAX, which no screen in Mexico City shows.

opened_as_laser.note: Named among the first three Cinemex laser complexes in December 2023.

screen_height_m.note: Sources disagree: 'casi 20 m' against 'mas de 18 m'. Neither is Cinemex's. Do not print a height.

screen_area_m2.note: Press: 'aproximadamente 300 metros cuadrados'. Say 'about 300 m2', never an exact figure.

billed_as.value: largest IMAX screen in Mexico City and Latin America
billed_as.note: A marketing superlative repeated by press, not a measurement.

seats_total.note: Session 65659658, 2026-12-16. 140 regular. Platino recliners, so few seats for the screen size.

label.note: On Cinemex's IMAX list. Do NOT label it 'IMAX with Laser': see projection.

projection.note: Contradicted. Cinemex's own laser sentence names Antara, Santa Fe, Parque Delta and Parque Tezontle and leaves Oceania out. Cine PREMIERE listed it among the planned laser rooms in 2023, and El Financiero calls Cinemex IMAX dual laser chain-wide. The operator's omission is the stronger evidence until Cinemex names it.

sound.note: Chain-level claim only, not about this room.

label.note: Cinepolis' own site cannot be read from this network, so no operator source.

projection.note: Contested. The audit records Infobae calling Cinepolis' CDMX IMAX sites laser and Omelete and Xataka saying dual xenon. El Financiero says only 'dual 4K projection', which fits either.

screen_area_m2.note: 21.3 x 13.7 is 291.8. Press calls it the largest Cinepolis screen in CDMX.

projection.note: Contested, same as Universidad: laser against dual xenon.

screen_area_m2.note: A range in the source, so show it as a range.

imax_in_cdmx_not_in_app.note: Listed as a Cinepolis IMAX site. Nothing else known.

what_not_to_say: Never '1.43:1' or 'IMAX 70mm' or 'IMAX GT' for any of these. All are digital 1.90:1.
Never 'IMAX with Laser' for Encuentro Oceania, Universidad or Forum Buenavista.
Never an exact screen height for Antara. The two press figures disagree.
'2K xenon' is not established for any room here. The contested Cinepolis sites are unknown, not xenon.
